title: Small steps: Autonomy needs information
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
pressureLine: You're not old enough to decide.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The adult still sets age-appropriate limits.
practice: explain the reason and identify what can be decided
principle: Support growing autonomy with transparent boundaries and information.
nextSentence: The adult still sets age-appropriate limits. First, explain the reason and identify what can be decided.
keyLearning: Support growing autonomy with transparent boundaries and information.
